name: God Rays
description: God rays: shafts of light stream out from a point through the bright parts of the picture.

params.name: center
params.description: Where the rays come from, 0..1 of the frame ([0, 0] = top-left)

params.name: length
params.description: Length of the rays, part of the way to the light

params.name: decay
params.description: How fast the rays fade along their length

params.name: threshold
params.description: Brightness (0..1) a pixel needs to cast rays

params.name: samples
params.description: Samples along each ray; more is smoother and slower
